definitions.explanation: A favorable point or benefit of something. Used when discussing the positive aspects of a choice, method, or situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利点|りてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What are the advantages of this method?

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧{利点|りてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ことだ。
examples.english: The advantage of living in the city is the good transportation access.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利点|りてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This product has many merits, but it also has the drawback of being expensive.

notes:
{利点|りてん} means a favorable point or benefit. Often used in analytical or comparative contexts, such as weighing options.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利点|りてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an advantage
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利点|りてん}: the greatest advantage
- {利点|りてん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧: advantages and disadvantages
- {利点|りてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to make the most of an advantage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メリット→メリット：06848_meritto⟧: merit, advantage (loanword, very common in casual speech)
- ⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧: strong point (often about people)
- ⟦{強|つよ}み→強み：12499_tsuyomi⟧: strength (personal or organizational)
- ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧: drawback, flaw
- ⟦デメリット→デメリット：06849_demeritto⟧: disadvantage, demerit
- ⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧: weak point
